method_notes: Sales Nav list pages are virtualised: JS returns 0 rows unless the tab has been painted. Force a paint with a tiny screenshot/zoom before running DOM reads.
List membership: page through &page=N (25/page), collect a[data-anonymize="company-name"] while scrolling. The 4-5 'Accounts with recent changes' cards use the same selector - subtract them.

To add: /sales/search/company?query=(spellCorrectionEnabled:true,keywords:NAME), then in the result row click the button whose aria-label matches /as an account|saved\. Add to a custom list/, wait ~1.5s, then click the button whose aria-label matches /to <List Name> list/.
An account already saved to another list shows 'Saved' instead of 'Save' - same dropdown, different aria-label.
